svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: datasheet: 32 x QSFP56-DD 400GbE. The guide's own LED table enumerates the modes each port runs - 400G and 2 x 200G and 4 x 100G on 50G PAM4, 100G and 4 x 25G on 25G NRZ, and 40G and 4 x 10G on 10G NRZ - which is a fuller statement of what works than the datasheet's port line gives.
